name: ProactiveBench
description: A dataset of 6,790 events collected from real-world human activities to train and evaluate proactive task prediction capabilities of LLM agents. It includes human-labeled data indicating acceptance or rejection of proactive task predictions and is used to fine-tune models to improve proactive assistance.
reputation: A newer benchmark for proactive LLM agents that has seen emerging use in proactive task prediction research but is not yet widely standardized.
notes: Dataset is human-labeled for acceptance/rejection of proactive task predictions; fine-tuning on this dataset improves LLM agent proactiveness.
